text:
sara-sales: Quick check — can we confirm network egress rules and cert handoff for the NovaHealth POC? Their infra team wants to lock down IPs before staging cutover. Looking at cutover window next Wed 10-12 PT. cc: @arun-se @maya-platform

arun-se: I can own API contract signoff + test harness. Need list of whitelisted IPs and TLS cert method.

maya-platform: we need to know if they'll use private VPC peering or public egress. Also need their CIDR and whether KMS/HSM needed for key wrap.

jon-enginfra: we can open these IPs from our side, but staging cluster is behind NAT; provide static egress list. If they want VPC peering, that's a different timeline (2-3 days ops work).

carlos-cs: Heads-up from customer — they prefer peering for compliance. I'll reconfirm and get CIDR and security POC.

eliza-se: Also pinging on integration deliverables: expected webhook format, auth header, retry semantics. I dropped a sample schema in the support ticket. link: https://redwood.atlassian/NR-2314

arun-se: sample schema looks good. For retries, we'll support an idempotency-key header. Adding note: prefer x-request-id for tracing.

maya-platform: For certs we support both customer-managed certs (PEM upload) and our cert management flow. If they need HSM-backed keys, that'll be part of Private offering — flagging compliance implications.

jon-enginfra: firewall snippet for staging NAT egress if they want IPs opened:
```
# allow NovaHealth staging NAT
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 198.51.100.0/24 -j ACCEPT
# allow control plane
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 203.0.113.5 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```

sara-sales: Great. Carlos — can you get CIDR and tell if they'll accept cert upload? Also can we move cutover to Thu 8-10 PT if peering required?

carlos-cs: On it. Asked them now. They prefer Thu 8-10 PT. CIDR coming in ~2 hrs.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary deploy for novahealth-poc v2 on 1749070000 — status: pending approval

maya-platform: FYI — if canary, need rollout policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m waits. I'll prepare rollout config and health checks.

arun-se: I'll queue a quick smoke test script that hits /health, /predict and validates idempotency semantics. @sara-sales can you add me to their Jira for access to API keys?

sara-sales: Added arun-se and maya-platform to NR-2314. Also attached test credentials (masked) — use dev key: sk_live_***

eliza-se: quick code review ping — PR #452 (webhook retry wrapper) updated to include idempotency-key and enhanced logging. @arun-se plz review.

arun-se: reviewing now, will approve if tests pass.

jon-enginfra: Timing note — our staging maintenance window is Thu 09:00-09:30 PT. If peering tasks overlap, we may need to shift. Let's keep Thu 08:00-10:00 but avoid 09:00-09:30.

sara-sales: noted. We'll avoid 09:00-09:30. Thanks everyone. I'll post a final runbook once CIDR confirmed.
